variants.maintainer_notes: New variant: the RAM variant's command with --write-flash. openFPGALoader loads its SPI-over-JTAG bridge for the FPGA part (xc7a35tcsg324, in oss-cad-suite's share/openFPGALoader), then writes the board's SPI flash. Not tried on hardware. USB filter: product_regex from a real Arty A7-35T (FTDI 0403:6010, product "Digilent USB Device", manufacturer "Digilent"), as the Basys3's; it lets hosts suggest the Arty for that device. Other Digilent boards likely report the same name but weren't checked, so they keep the chip ids only. Device selection (2026-11-04): --busdev-num ${BUS}:${DEV} added so openFPGALoader opens the device the engine chose, not the first one with these USB IDs. Low risk, so tested is unchanged: openFPGALoader's FTDI drivers (MPSSE, bitbang, CH552) open the device by bus and address when given (src/ftdipp_mpsse.cpp, ftdi_usb_open_bus_addr); not tried on hardware.
